## Checklist

### Code

- [ ] Lint & typecheck pass (`pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck`)

### Backend

- [ ] No breaking changes (or documented)

### Testing

- [ ] Tested locally
- [ ] Added/updated tests (if applicable)
